subject: Punishment of offences committed beyond, which by law may be tried within, India.
summary: Section is included as a subsection in BNS sans heading. “Indian laws” is replaced with “law" and “for the time being in force in India" is inserted.

subject: "Counterfeit".
summary: No change.

subject: Month and year.
summary: “British calendar” is replaced by “Gregorian calendar”.

subject: Gaining wrongfully, losing wrongfully.
summary: No change.

subject: Sentence may be (in certain cases of imprisonment) wholly or partly rigorous or simple.
summary: No change.

subject: Abetment outside India for offence in India.
summary: “A person abets an offence within the meaning of this Sanhita who, without and beyond India, abets the commission of any act in India which would constitute an offence if committed in India”.

subject: Husband or relative of husband of a woman subjecting her to cruelty.
summary: No change.

subject: Wrongful confinement of person for whose liberation writ has been issued.
summary: IPC section is included as a sub-section in BNS sans heading. Fine is added.

subject: Importation of girl or boy from foreign country.
summary: Words “any boy under the age of eighteen years” added and “she” is replaced by “girl or boy”.

subject: Candidate, electoral right defined.
summary: No change.

subject: Possession of forged or counterfeit coin, Government stamp, currency-notes or bank-notes.
summary: Six sections of IPC have been covered in this single section of BNS. Thus, in a single stroke, the number of sections and offences has been reduced by five. and 'not constitute a n offence' is added.

subject: Unlawful assembly- Hiring, or conniving at hiring, of persons to join unlawful assembly.
summary: Ditto.

subject: Assaulting or obstructing public servant when suppressing riot, etc.
summary: In cases where the offender threatens to assault or attempts to obstruct a public servant or threatens or attempts to use criminal force on a public servant in the described situations, the punishment includes imprisonment of a term that may extend to one year. A fine may also be imposed under this sub-section. This is a rare case of a reduction in punishment.

subject: False information, with intent to cause public servant to use his lawful power to the injury of another person.
summary: The upper limit of imprisonment increased from six months to one year, and the fine increased from one thousand to ten thousand r upees.

subject: Omission to assist public servant when bound by law to give assistance.
summary: Section is reorganised in the form of clauses (a) and (b) without changing the essence, and the upper limit of the fine is increased from two hundred to two thousand and five hundred rupees and five hundred to five thousand rupees.

subject: Using as true a certificate known to be false.
summary: No change.

subject: False statement made in declaration which is by law receivable as evidence.
summary: Words “Court of Justice” is replaced by “Court”.

subject: Personation of assessor.
summary: In heading “Personation of assessor” is used in place of “juror or assessor” and word "juryman" is excluded.

subject: Deliberate and malicious acts intended to outrage religious feelings of any class, by insulting its religion or religious beliefs.
summary: Words “or through electronic means” are added.

subject: Theft.
summary: IPC section is included as sub section. “Definition” is replaced by “Section” in explanation 5.

subject: Putting person in fear or accusation of offence, in order to commit extortion.
summary: Ditto.

subject: Assembling for purpose of committing dacoity.
summary: The IPC section is included as sub-section in BNS, sans heading. Words “at any time after the passing of this Act, shall” is removed.

subject: Dishonestly receiving stolen property.
summary: IPC Section is included as sub-section in BNS sans heading.

subject: Habitually dealing in stolen property.
summary: Ditto.

subject: Possesses any seal, plate or other instrument knowing the same to be counterfeit.
summary: “Whoever possesses any seal, plate or other instrument knowing the same to be counterfeit, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years, and shall also be liable to fine”.

subject: Property mark.
summary: IPC section is included as a sub-section in BNS.

subject: Intentional insult with intent to provoke breach of the peace.
summary: Words “in any manner” are added.

subject: Subordination of Judicial Magistrates.
summary: No change.

subject: Public to give information of certain offences.
summary: Ditto.

subject: Examination of person accused of rape by medical practitioner.
summary: The words "police officer not below the rank of Sub- Inspector" are replaced by "any police officer".

subject: Procedure by Magistrate before whom such person arrested is brought.
summary: The word "bail" is replaced by "bail bond".

subject: Police officer's power to investigate cognizable case.
summary: A new proviso to subsection (1) is added. Sub-section (4) is newly added to protect public servants in the course of discharge of public duty against undue harassment, and subsection (3) is also amended according to sub-section(4) of section 173.

subject: Examination of witnesses by police.
summary: No change.

subject: Offences committed by means of electronic communications, letters, etc.
summary: The words "electronic communications" added. BNS sections replace corresponding IPC sections.

subject: Prosecution of offences under section 498A of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023.
summary: No change.

subject: Postponement of issue of process.
summary: No change.

subject: Effect of errors.
summary: No change.

subject: Conviction on plea of guilty in absence of accused in petty cases.
summary: "pleader" is replaced by "advocate".

subject: Application for plea bargaining.
summary: Time limit for plea bargaining "within a period of thirty days from the date of framing of charge" is added in subsection (1). 290 (4) (a) "not exceeding sixty days" is added, regarding accused to work out a mutually satisfactory disposition of the case". The words “as the case may be” excluded.

subject: Oral arguments and memorandum of arguments.
summary: No change.

subject: Order for notifying address of previously convicted offender.
summary: Reframing of phrases without any change in essence.

subject: Order to release on probation of good conduct or after admonition.
summary: The words "with or without sureties" are excluded “or bail bond" are added. ‘the Children Act 1960 (60 of 1960)" is replaced by "The Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015".

subject: Practicing advocate not to sit as Magistrate in certain Courts.
summary: The word "pleader" is replaced by "advocate".

subject: "shall presume".
summary: No change.

subject: Facts tending to enable Court to determine amount are relevant in suits for damages.
summary: No change except in the heading, where the words "In suits for damages" are placed at the end instead of the beginning.

subject: Proof as to electronic signature.
summary: No change.

subject: Court to decide when question shall be asked and when witness compelled to answer.
summary: Word "namely" is added in its subsection (2).

subject: Question not to be asked without reasonable grounds.
summary: In illustrations, the words "barrister", "an attorney or vakil", "dakait" and "A pleader" are replaced by words "advocate", "another advocate", "dacoit" and "a advocate" respectively.

subject: Refreshing memory.
summary: Paragraphs are numbered as subsections (1) and (2). Sub-heading words "When witness may use copy of document to refresh memory" are excluded from subsection (2). Words "Provided that" and "Provided further that" are added in provisos.

subject: Judge's power to put questions or order production.
summary: Words "proper", "please" and "relevant or irrelevant" are excluded. Word "agents" is replaced by "representatives".
